_doc: Self-consistency round-trip baseline for the builtin-parity test (plan §12.1). NOT a recording of an actual Layer1Solver/legacy-path run — these values are hand-authored to EQUAL the synthetic input fixture (cobench_2task.json), so the test asserts BuiltinBackend passes its scores through unchanged AND records the (outer_prompt, outer_completion, inner=0) tuple with token_basis='outer'. To make a true cross-path golden later, record this from an actual --base-solver builtin co_bench run and note the provenance. Keyed by task_id.
